name: ANSI/IEEE Differential-current measuring relay form
summary: IEEE-library form of differential-current measuring relay: a differential-current relay responds to the relationship between specified current inputs.
description: This reference locates differential-current measuring relay in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented current protection relays family. A differential-current relay responds to the relationship between specified current inputs. The schematic must identify input directions, ratio matching and the protected or monitored zone. The public library uses HCR1F29 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Trace the measured quantity or initiating control signal separately from the output contacts. The device tag links the sensing or operating element to the controlled circuit; settings, reset behaviour and the actual terminal arrangement belong in the selected equipment documentation.

Follow polarity and reference directions on all compared current circuits. Differential measurement is not simply a single high-current threshold. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
